principle: Do not repeatedly rescue unresolved O-universe members. Preserve them in the official audit universe, but exclude them from the operational/ranking denominator when status cannot be verified within the bounded check.

official_universe.denominator_semantics: Official HK Connect union snapshot. Never shrink this number merely to hide failures.

operational_universe.denominator_semantics: Only members with sufficiently verified current-session status participate in O ranking/formal acceptance.
operational_universe.reentry_rule: A previously excluded symbol may re-enter on a later session only if the normal scheduled/current-session refresh independently yields a clear verified status. Do not launch a bespoke rescue job solely to restore it.
operational_universe.formal_acceptance_rule: 100% of the effective operational denominator must have valid comparable formal O results; excluded unresolved members are audited separately and do not remain in the ranking denominator.
